verdict.rationale: Operating a compliance SaaS through natural-language commands is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence does not show it: there are AI-driven automations (website risk review, alert adjudication), a no-code dashboard editor, APIs and an llms.txt docs file. None of these is a natural-language command interface, and the llms.txt file only serves documentation to LLMs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
